description: Searches open government contract notices: RFPs, RFIs, BAAs and solicitations from SAM.gov, including presolicitation and sources sought notices (marked as not biddable), and bids from some state and local procurement portals. Grants are excluded. Inputs: query (keywords) or queries (1 to 5 variations merged into one deduplicated list), and optional filters for status, deadline window, date added, procurement type and SAM.gov fields (NAICS, set-aside, department, place of performance); user_context (organization type and location) refines ranking. With a place-of-performance state, the response's placeOfPerformance field counts results confirmed in that state, results with no confirmed location, and results excluded for another state. Returns a page of matching notices (15 by default) with buyer, response deadline, status and the official notice link. Counts toward the search allowance. A multi-query call counts once.

compact.description: Whether results are compact (default: true); false returns full details.

deadline_within_days.description: Only opportunities closing within N days

detail_level.description: Batch mode only: controls response verbosity (minimal/compact [default]/full). Ignored in single-query mode.

limit.description: Max results (default: 15, max: 100; values above 100 are treated as 100). The nextCursor of the response continues to the next page.

max_response_tokens.description: Batch mode only: token budget for the response (default 4000). Server auto-caps results to fit. Ignored in single-query mode.

max_results.description: Batch mode only: maximum merged results to return (default 10). Ignored in single-query mode, where limit applies.

min_quality.description: Minimum record-completeness tier (default: medium). any removes this quality-tier filter; relevance, access and other filters still apply.

new_within_days.description: Older name for posted_within_days, kept for compatibility: only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). The response includes newSince (count and newest and oldest added times) and windowCoverage.

offset.description: Batch mode only: number of merged results to skip for pagination (default 0). Ignored in single-query mode.

posted_within_days.description: Only opportunities FundingLandscape added in the last N days, by the date added (not the posted date or the deadline). Same as new_within_days; when both are set, this value applies. With no query, the page is sampled across sources, and windowCoverage reports how many sources were sampled and served, the order ("recency" or "relevance"), and whether a retrieval limit cut the window.

procurement_type.description: Industry type. professional_services = consulting/engineering/R&D (NAICS 54xxxx). it_services = software/IT (NAICS 5415xx). construction = building (NAICS 23xxxx). manufacturing = production (NAICS 31-33xxxx).

queries.description: Batch mode: an array of 1 to 5 query variations, run together and merged into one deduplicated list. When set, query is ignored and detail_level, max_results, offset and max_response_tokens shape the merged list. Available on accounts that include multi-query search; other accounts receive a notice. Example: ["IT services contract", "software development federal", "technology consulting government"].

query.description: Natural language search query. When queries is set, query is ignored.

department.description: Top-level federal department or independent agency, e.g. "Department of Energy", "DOE", "Defense", "GSA". Matched against the live SAM.gov department facet (agency name, acronym, or "Department of X" phrasing all resolve); an unrecognized value is applied as-is and reported in the response as departmentFilter. Sub-agencies such as the Air Force are matched through the query text, not this field.

place_of_performance_state.description: Two-letter state code where the work is performed (e.g., "CA", "TX"). pop_state is accepted as the same field.

pop_state.description: Alias for place_of_performance_state: a state code (e.g., "CA", "TX"). When both are sent, place_of_performance_state applies.

set_aside.description: Set-aside type. Supported: SDVOSB, VOSB, WOSB, EDWOSB, 8a/8(a), HUBZone, SBA/"Small Business" (each expands to all matching SAM codes and CSV labels). Restricts results to the chosen set-aside type.

since.description: Stateless alternative to posted_within_days/new_within_days: ISO 8601 instant. Only opportunities ingested at or after this instant. The newSince.newest of a previous response is a valid value, which gives a stateless watermark.

source.description: Source domain to match, e.g. "sam.gov" or an agency source domain.

exclude_naics_prefixes.description: NAICS prefixes to exclude (e.g., ["31","32","33"] for manufacturing).

location.description: US state (two-letter code or name), or "nationwide".

location_strict.description: With a recognized location, requests geographic filtering; nationwide or unspecified records and explicitly broader fallbacks may remain, as geographyFilterOutcome and warnings report. With sam_filters.place_of_performance_state (or pop_state in batch), true additionally excludes records without a confirmed performance location; false demotes and caveats them.

organization_type.description: Common natural-language phrasing (e.g. "501(c)(3) nonprofit") is also parsed; unparseable values are ignored with an explicit note in the response. A tribal government fits government and a tribal nonprofit fits nonprofit.

name: search_procurement
title: Search Contracts & RFPs
